children.value: > Fact From Story | Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said that since this morning, Israel had been at war and its first objective was to clear out the hostile forces that infiltrated its territory.
> > Fact From Story | Israel wanted to invade Palestine, but they had no excuse.
> > > Fact From Story | Hamas is an excuse, new lands are wonderful.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | A common goal of war is to gain territory.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | Wars are often used as justification for territorial expansion.
> Fact From Story | Some speculated that Mossad knew what was going to happen but let Hamas make a mistake so that Israel could launch a ferocious attack on it.
> Commonsense Knowledge | Countries often use events to justify actions they planned to take anyway.
